title: Design System: Kyle Young Editorial Engineering Dossier

display.purpose: Large proof statements, section headers, and case-study titles.

hero.purpose: Oversized Kyle Young hero type that composes with the extended bottom-anchored portrait.

body.purpose: Readable project descriptions, about copy, and supporting evidence.

label.purpose: Navigation, dates, roles, tags, and compact structured labels.

shadows.name: poster-frame-lift
shadows.purpose: Separate the off-white identity poster from the dark page shell.

shadows.name: soft-proof-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift homepage media proof on warm paper surfaces.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for light evidence panels.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and gentle lift.

motion.name: hero-load-reveal
motion.purpose: Initial navigation, name, portrait, role, and social-link entrance.

motion.name: media-hover-lift
motion.purpose: Make evidence media feel responsive without becoming decorative.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Disable parallax, hover transforms, and reveal transforms under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for primary project and contact paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #f4f1e9; border-radius: 28px; background: #f4f1e9; color: #0d1113; font: 700 0.72rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #73a9d6; border-color: #73a9d6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #73a9d6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action that stays within the dark industrial shell.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.16); border-radius: 28px; background: rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.04); color: #f4f1e9; font: 700 0.72rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.32); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #73a9d6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Fixed Navigation
components.description: Dark fixed navigation with compact uppercase labels and a blue active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 74px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 34px); padding: 0 clamp(18px, 5vw, 88px); background: rgba(13, 17, 19, 0.985); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.17); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.68); font: 700 0.68rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 8px; height: 1px; background: #73a9d6; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #f4f1e9; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #73a9d6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Poster
components.description: The signature identity composition: off-white frame, extended bottom-anchored portrait, oversized name, role lockup, and social links.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-poster { --hero-axis-y: 50%; --portrait-width: clamp(360px, 34vw, 620px); --portrait-sink: clamp(96px, 16vh, 220px); position: relative; min-height: 84vh; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(13, 17, 19, 0.54); border-radius: 28px; background: #f4f1e9; color: #0d1113; box-shadow: 0 18px 58px rgba(13, 17, 19, 0.18); } .ds-poster-name { position: absolute; left: clamp(18px, 3.4vw, 58px); right: clamp(18px, 3.4vw, 58px); top: var(--hero-axis-y); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font: 700 clamp(6rem, 12.4vw, 15rem)/0.98 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.018em; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-poster-portrait { position: absolute; left: 47%; bottom: calc(-1 * var(--portrait-sink)); z-index: 2; width: var(--portrait-width); aspect-ratio: 0.66; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-poster-portrait img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 57% 0%; } .ds-poster-role { position: absolute; right: clamp(28px, 3.2vw, 58px); bottom: clamp(24px, 3.8vh, 48px); z-index: 3; margin: 0; color: rgba(8, 10, 11, 0.92); font: 500 clamp(2.05rem, 3.3vw, 4.1rem)/1 Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; text-align: right; }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Large project proof row with media, concise copy, and metadata.
components.html:
Selected work

Design, fabrication, test evidence, and iteration notes.
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(24px, 5vw, 76px); align-items: center; padding: clamp(42px, 7vw, 112px) 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(13, 17, 19, 0.12); color: #0d1113; } .ds-evidence-media { min-height: clamp(280px, 32vw, 520px); margin: 0; border-radius: 28px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%, rgba(255, 250, 240, 0.92), transparent 55%), rgba(255, 250, 240, 0.52); box-shadow: 0 22px 72px rgba(13, 17, 19, 0.28); } .ds-evidence-row h3 { margin: 0; font: 900 clamp(2rem, 4.4vw, 5rem)/0.94 Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.018em; } .ds-evidence-row p { color: rgba(13, 17, 19, 0.68); font: 500 1rem/1.62 Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-kicker { color: #2c66ad !important; font: 800 0.68rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace !important; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Compact structured label for roles, dates, tags, and technical categories.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 30px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.16); border-radius: 999px; color: rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.68); background: rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.04); font: 700 0.68rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #f4f1e9; border-color: rgba(244, 241, 233, 0.32); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #73a9d6; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio presents Kyle Young as a hands-on mechanical engineer through a first viewport that behaves like an editorial poster: a dark industrial page shell, an off-white framed identity field, oversized cropped name typography, and an extended side-profile portrait that is bottom-anchored so the body continues through the frame edge. The person is the first signal; the project evidence follows as calm, scannable proof.

The system is precise, minimal, luminous, and work-focused. It uses real artifacts, compact metadata, disciplined rows, and restrained UCLA blue rather than decorative tech effects. The dark page gives the work an engineering-lab context, while the warm poster paper keeps the introduction personal and memorable.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white identity poster inside a dark industrial portfolio shell.
Oversized name typography layered with a real portrait, never an illustrated replacement.
Restrained graphite, warm off-white, and UCLA blue with very few accent moments.
Spacious evidence rows and proof panels instead of generic equal card grids.
Motion is subtle, visible without JavaScript, and disabled for reduced motion.

rules.name: The Blue Rarity Rule
rules.body: Blue should be a signal, not a wash. Use it for interaction, metadata, and small technical emphasis before using it as a large surface.

rules.name: The Real Evidence Rule
rules.body: Generated or atmospheric imagery may support the system, but project proof should come from repository assets or explicitly confirmed real artifacts.

rules.name: The Monospace Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono only for navigation, metadata, labels, and measurement-like text. Do not use it as a decorative signifier for "technical."

rules.name: The Shadow Must Explain Layering Rule
rules.body: Shadows should describe a real surface relationship or interaction state. Avoid colored glow as decoration.

dos: Do keep the portrait, name typography, and hero role lockup visually registered as one poster composition.
Do use real project imagery and repository evidence wherever available.
Do keep blue rare and intentional.
Do use large, calm type for proof moments and compact mono labels for structured details.
Do preserve visible focus states and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the homepage into a grid of same-size generic cards.
Don't use neon glow, rainbow gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative HUD overlays.
Don't replace Kyle's portrait with an illustration or generated face.
Don't use monospace as a general body or heading costume.
Don't let the hero portrait float upward from the bottom edge when resizing; the lower body should pass through the frame.
